requirements.text: 3+ years in a high-intensity environment (strategy consulting, VC/PE, or a high-growth startup) where you owned outcomes, not just tasks
Strong academic credentials or an equivalent track record of exceptional achievement
High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the humility to step in wherever needed
Builds executive-grade decks, documents, and narratives that convince and inspire
Comfortable interacting with senior internal and external stakeholders
Builder mentality: executes, thrives in ambiguity, makes the call when there is no playbook
First-principles thinking: questions why things exist before rebuilding them
Owns complex, cross-functional special projects end-to-end
Runs company-critical internal communications, including the monthly All-Hands
AI-native: uses AI tools and automation to work more effectively
Experience with automation platforms such as n8n
Able to work from the Berlin headquarters five days per week

resumes.text:
Julia Ferreira
Summary: Strategy and operations lead with 6 years in high-growth startups and strategy consulting. Owns outcomes end-to-end, writes clear executive narratives and automates routine work.

Experience
Chief of Staff, Kestrel Logistics (Series C scale-up, Lisbon), 2022 to 2025
- Owned cross-functional special projects end-to-end, including a nine-month cost programme that cut operating spend by 14 percent.
- Built executive-grade decks, board narratives and quarterly documents used by the CEO and board.
- Briefed C-level executives, investors and external partners on programme status.
- Ran the monthly company all-hands, covering agenda, content and delivery.
- Use AI tools and automation to build weekly reporting workflows that saved the leadership team about six hours each week.
- Built automations in Zapier for lead routing and internal approvals.
- When there was no pricing playbook, stood up the function from scratch and owned the results.
- Questioned why the legacy onboarding steps existed, rebuilt the process from first principles and cut time-to-value from 45 days to 18.

Associate, Brightwell Partners (strategy consultancy, Lisbon and Madrid), 2019 to 2022
- Mentored three junior analysts and resolved a staffing dispute across two client teams.
- Supported strategy engagements for retail and telecom clients.

Education
BSc Economics, Universidade Nova de Lisboa, 2018. National mathematics olympiad gold medal and full scholarship.

Skills
Executive communication, storytelling, financial modelling, Zapier, Python, Notion, Google Workspace. Fluent in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Availability
Currently fully remote. Can visit the Berlin office for about two weeks per quarter, but not five days a week.

Sofia Meyer
Summary: Operations and communications coordinator with 2 years in a mid-size management consultancy. Strong with clients and slides, eager to take on more ownership. Based in Hamburg.

Experience
Operations Associate, Varden & Co. (management consultancy, Hamburg), 2023 to 2025
- Coordinated internal operations for a 60-person team, including onboarding and resourcing.
- Owned end-to-end delivery of a cross-functional onboarding project for the Hamburg office.
- Built client-ready executive-grade decks and summary documents that partners used in pitches.
- Took on a client pricing analysis when the team had no existing method, and delivered a recommendation the partner used in the final presentation.
- Mentored a new intern on the reporting template and kept the client status pack on schedule.
- Used AI tools to draft first versions of client summaries, then checked them for accuracy before sending.
- Organised logistics for the company's summer event.
- Supported strategy projects for a logistics client, including market sizing and interviews.
- Built the weekly status dashboard for the operations team in Excel and kept it updated through two office moves.
- Drafted meeting notes and action logs for internal project reviews, circulating them within a day of each meeting.
- Managed the onboarding checklist and equipment set-up for new consultants joining the Hamburg office.
- Prepared the travel and logistics plan for a three-day client workshop attended by 40 people.

Education
BA Business Administration, University of Hamburg, 2022

Skills
PowerPoint, Excel, Google Sheets, project coordination, client communication. Fluent in German and English.

Availability
Able to relocate to Berlin and work on-site five days a week.

Nina Kovac
Summary: Veterinary clinic manager with 9 years running a busy animal hospital in Berlin. Focused on patient care, staff rotas and keeping the practice running smoothly around the clock.

Experience
Clinic Manager, Tierklinik Friedrichshain (Berlin), 2019 to 2025
- Managed the daily operations of a 24-hour animal hospital with a team of 28 veterinary nurses, technicians and receptionists.
- Regularly briefed senior clinicians and hospital directors on treatment plans and budget needs.
- Built the monthly staff rota to cover night shifts and public holidays.
- Reduced medicine stock waste by 22 percent through a new ordering schedule.
- Coordinated emergency intake during the busy summer months.
- Introduced a weekly stock audit and a supplier review that cut emergency reorders by a third.
- Led the monthly team meeting on infection control and hygiene procedures for all clinical staff.
- Managed the clinic's annual licence renewals and inspections with the regional veterinary authority.
- Set up the new pharmacy room and the controlled-drug log, passing the first external audit without findings.
- Trained four new nurses on triage scoring, handover notes and client communication for distressed owners.

Veterinary Nurse, Tierklinik Friedrichshain (Berlin), 2016 to 2019
- Assisted in surgery and anaesthesia monitoring for dogs, cats and small mammals.
- Ran the front-desk triage process for walk-in emergencies.

Education
Veterinary Nurse Diploma, Berlin Vocational College, 2016

Skills
Rota planning, inventory control, patient care, anaesthesia monitoring, Microsoft Excel, customer communication. Fluent in German, conversational English.

Availability
Based in Berlin. Working on-site five days a week for the past eight years.
